question.latex: For a given circuit the time dependent input voltage $v_{in}(t)$ is a sine wave alternating between $20\text{V}$ and $-20\text{V}$. The corresponding output $v_o(t)$ is clipped flat at $+5\text{V}$ and $-5\text{V}$. Identify the components that are used in the circuit in the parallel branch between points X and Y to produce this clipped output.
